chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Said from Ibn Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Zurarah who said:

Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: "Friday prayer is obligatory for one who, if he prays the morning prayer in his home, will catch the Friday prayer. And the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) would only pray the afternoon prayer during the time of the noon prayer on all other days, so that when they had completed the prayer with the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family), they would return to their homes before nightfall. And that is a Sunnah until the Day of Resurrection."
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on Friday prayer and how did the Prophet combine prayers to facilitate the congregation?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Baqir (AS) clarifies the legal ruling that Friday prayer is obligatory even for those who pray Fajr at home, provided they join the congregational prayer. It highlights the Prophet’s (PBUH) strategic practice of delaying Asr to coincide with Dhuhr, a practical measure to facilitate the community's return home before nightfall, which is established as a permanent Sunnah.
